document_kind: Independent lane contribution to existing XI-IO framework rebaseline
lane: Movie Night app lane, interaction-to-platform reuse review
status: CANDIDATE_FOR_TEAM_COMPARISON; not adopted baseline or observed defect census
grouping: Ten editorial groups of ten; not ROTFL gate collapse or 100 qualified cells

priorities.R1: First reuse leverage: common host, settings, identity and query code
priorities.R2: Next reuse leverage: repeated collections, chat, connections, editing and evidence states
priorities.R3: Composition leverage after foundations: lifecycle, white-label output and collaboration

priority_note: Qualitative duplication-removal ordering, not measured savings, severity or a launch permission. Authorization and data-loss defects outrank this sequencing.
non_goals: No installed or suite adoption claim
No new canonical Work, worker, quorum or product registry

families.name: Window geometry and universal utilities
families.why: One host geometry and utility implementation replaces app-specific chrome, sizing rules and entrypoint wiring.
families.owner_boundary: Existing shared Desktop/frame and utility owners

families.name: Declaration-driven settings and preferences
families.why: One declaration and interpreter remove duplicate defaults, allowed-value lists and hand-written settings metadata.
families.owner_boundary: Existing Settings, DataForge declaration and SDK owners; product owns domain bindings

families.name: Record identity, selection and action boundaries
families.why: A stable selection contract eliminates separate card/list/detail identities and prevents accidental domain effects.
families.owner_boundary: Existing SDK, Articles/Publisher and shared selection owners; effects stay product-owned

families.name: Search, provider facets and query semantics
families.why: One predicate and query model removes inconsistent search, wall, carousel, saved-view and count implementations.

families.name: Collections, navigation and efficient repeated content
families.why: Shared collection behaviour removes independent pagination, carousel, row-ordering and return-navigation implementations.
families.owner_boundary: Existing collection/selection primitives with product-specific data adapters

families.name: Contextual chat and assistant interaction
families.why: One existing conversation engine can serve docked, detached and standalone hosts without duplicating chat state.
families.owner_boundary: Existing @ibal/conversation owner and shared window host; no replacement chat engine

families.name: Connections, authorized libraries and import workflows
families.why: A shared connection and BINS workflow avoids per-product account pickers, import stores and inconsistent access checks.
families.owner_boundary: Existing Integrations, BINS and Ward owners; authentication stays provider-specific

families.name: Editing, persistence and reversible operations
families.why: Shared edit-session and command-state semantics remove inconsistent Save, Cancel, reset, conflict and export handling.
families.owner_boundary: Existing file-command, authoring and revision owners; persistence engines remain domain-owned

families.name: Truthful state, provenance and accessibility
families.why: Consistent state and evidence primitives remove repeated ambiguous spinners, false greens and inaccessible recovery controls.
families.owner_boundary: Existing SDK status/evidence and accessibility owners; backend states retain their meaning

families.name: Plugin lifecycle, white-label publishing and collaboration
families.why: Once foundational contracts pass, one set of lifecycle and composition surfaces scales to many products and sites.
families.owner_boundary: Existing lifecycle, Articles/Publisher and collaboration owners; domain rules stay with products
